rationale.campaign_length: F30直接任务定义52项，含阶段条件和分支，不等于同局全可完成。
rationale.colonization: 已核实的F30任务不以海外殖民为主循环。
rationale.complexity: 开局事件、三阶段任务、信仰分支、佣兵骑兵与后期危机互相交织。
rationale.dark_story: 旧帝国复仇与深海威胁带有阴影，但现有证据不足以描述为系统性暴行。
rationale.difficulty: 附庸与阶段门槛使推进较难；现版平衡未实机评测。
rationale.diplomacy: 开局谋求独立支持，并有宗教与鹰身女妖关系分支。
rationale.early_pressure: 1444瓦拉姆哈尔附庸，需要安排独立支持及事件选择。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 太阳骑手、战斗法师、魔法研究和海岸仪式有持续作用；骑兵与政治同样重要。
rationale.narrative_density: 从低语与阴影到独立、古帝国复兴和第二次猛攻构成连续故事。
rationale.tall_play: 农田、城市与古代遗物建设占据可观任务比重。
rationale.trade_economy: 农业、城市与佣兵供给重要，但商贸不是最鲜明身份。
rationale.warfare: 独立战争、苏兰统一、骑兵佣兵升级及帝国复兴贯穿主线。

identity.appearance: 1444开局人类阿卡尔邦，为瓦拉姆哈尔F42附庸
identity.formation_scope: 52项F30任务分开局事件树、独立后主树与卡尔卡什卢后续；在专属事件中可保留F30、选择形成苏拉克什F52，贾德路线可在任务终段形成贾德帝国F51
successors: 贾德路线条件满足时可形成贾德帝国F51

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
当贾赫到达时，他真正体现了苏雷尔的威严、力量和权力。每当我们目睹我们的萨拉卡辅兵——太阳骑士——时，我们就会想起他：这是一支精灵法师的精锐部队，由我们在瓦拉姆哈尔的统治者提供，在库马尔坎德最好的战马上施着强大的魔法。在他们的帮助下，我们的骑兵可以炸开任何敌人。

(当然，我们的一些公民抱怨说，如果接受同等的培训，他们可以做得同样好，甚至更好……)
description.text_en:
When Jaher arrived, he truly embodied Surael's awesomeness, strength, and power. We are reminded of him every time we bear witness to our Sarraka auxiliaries, the Sunriders: an elite force of elven mages, provided by our overlords in Varamhar, slinging powerful magic atop Kumarkand's finest warhorses. With their assistance, our cavalry can blast apart any foe.

(Of course, some of our citizens grumble they could do as good or better provided equal training...)

description.text: 库马尔坎德定义了农耕，也被农耕定义。毫不夸张地说，我们国家的名字的意思是农田。在我们作为一个政体存在之前，我们就以将该地区干旱的土地变成葱茏的绿树而闻名。只要苏兰河还在流淌，只要苏雷尔的太阳还在照耀，我们就会继续这样做。
description.text_en: Kumarkand defines, and is defined by, farming. Quite literally, our country's name means farmland. Since before we existed as a polity, we made our name in turning the region's arid land into lush verdure. And as long as the Suran flows, as long as Surael's sun shines bright over head, we shall continue to do so.

description.text:
在布勒瓦尔，库马尔坎德人经常被嘲笑为顽固和不屈的一群人。但是，如果他们遇到了我们的马，他们就会明白为什么。这些野兽比最不老练的人类还要顽固两倍，而控制它们也需要一个同样强硬的民族。

但是，可惜的是，他们永远也学不会这一点，因为只有在我们自己的土地里才能找到这种工作出色的生物。它坚韧的力量和不屈不挠的精神保证了我们的农民在整个布勒瓦尔种植最好和最多的农产品。
description.text_en:
Across Bulwar, the Kumarkandi are often derided as a stubborn and unyielding lot. But, if they ever met our horses, they would understand why. The beasts are twice as stubborn as even the most undiplomatic human, and it takes a people just as tough to control them.

But alas, they shall never quite learn this, for this well-worked creature can only be found in our own fields. And its rugged strength and indomitable spirit is what ensures our farmers grow the best and most produce in all Bulwar.

description.text:
大多数库马尔坎德人满足于在家庭农场工作，照料他们父亲的父亲的父亲的田地。但每隔一段时间，就会有一个与众不同的人出生，他寻求在新的天空下不同的牧场上漫游。

然而，无论他们走到哪里，他们都带着库马尔坎德人与生俱来的技能：忠诚、决心、坚韧和自给自足。因此，许多人成为有天赋的游骑兵和冒险者也就不足为奇了（同样，当他们以低价为自己的祖国提供服务时也不足为奇）。
description.text_en:
Most Kumarkandi are content to spend their lives working the family farm, tending the fields of their fathers and their fathers' fathers. But every so often, one is born who is different, who seeks to wander different pastures under new skies.

Wherever they go, however, they carry with them the skills in-born to any Kumarkandi: loyalty, determination, fortitude, self-sufficiency. It is thus unsurprising many become talented rangers and adventurers (and similarly unsurprising when they offer their birth-country their services at reduced prices).

description.text:
「上等的阿布图卡提是用优质的精制面粉制成的，没有糠和谷壳等杂质，里面有大量的盐来降低密度。让它充分发酵，制成质地轻盈的面包。把面团揉好，等它发起来，再揉一次，分成几份，等它发起来。要保证薄的稠度，这样烘焙时就会产生更多的气泡。与蘸酱、肉和橄榄油一起食用。」

——摘自10世纪著名的《菜之书》，描述了制作同样著名的库马尔坎德面包的过程。库马尔坎德面包是每一餐的主食，也是每一段旅程的忠实伴侣。
description.text_en:
"Good abtu khati is made of quality refined flour, free of impurities such as husk and bran, with plenty of salt in it to break down its density. Let it ferment well, to create a good bread with airy and light texture. Knead the dough very well, let it rise, knead it again, divide it into portions, and wait until they rise. Ensure thin consistency, so it develops more bubbles as it bakes. Serve with dips, meats, and olive oil."

-An excerpt from The Book of Dishes, a famed 10th century text, describing the preparation of an equally famous Kumarkandi bread — the staple of every meal, and a faithful companion on every journey.

description.text:
几个世纪前，鹰身女妖女族长国将库马尔坎德当成自己的私人狩猎场，肆意猎食庄稼、牲畜和人类。田地变得荒芜，被野蛮的收割者蹂躏，被农场工人遗弃。然后德莫斯来了。

他身穿明亮的青铜盔甲，戴着金色面具，光彩照人地站在克沙拉拉纳兹平原上——一个不可抗拒的目标。在几个月的时间里，他用弓、矛和剑，杀死了几十个想要占有他的鹰身女妖。只有当女王本人冒着狂风暴雨来的时候，她们才有能力抵挡住他。就连她也抓不住他；他们的决斗以对德莫斯致命的一击而告终，女族长扑扇着翅膀飞走，翅膀被割掉了（几周后她就因伤势过重而死）。

后来，当地农民犹豫地走近这位英雄的尸体，第一次把他的面具揭了出来。他们发现他是一个半精灵，是唯一一个在库马尔坎德行走的精灵。虽然布勒瓦尔的顽固分子谴责这是令人憎恶的，但我们知道真相：他是被苏雷尔选中的，而「半日」德莫斯直到今天仍然是一个传奇人物。
description.text_en:
Centuries ago, the Harpy Matriarchy treated Kumarkand as its personal hunting grounds, preying upon crops, livestock, and men with abandon. The fields grew desolate, ravaged by these savage reapers and abandoned by farmworkers. And then Demos arrived.

Adorned in bright bronze armor and a golden mask, he stood bright on the plains of Xharraranaz — an irresistible target. Over many months, with bow and spear and sword, he slew dozens of harpies who sought to claim him as their own. It was only when the Matriarch herself came, amidst a storm of wind and rain, that any of them could stand against him. And even she could not capture him; their duel ended in a mortal blow to Demos, the matriarch fluttering away with a wing sliced off (she would die of her wounds a few weeks later).

Afterwards, the local farmers hesitantly approached the hero's corpse, and unmasked him for the first time. They discovered that he was a half-elf, the only one ever known to walk the fields of Kumarkand. And while the stiff-necks in Bulwar decried this as abomination, we know the truth: he was chosen by Surael, and Demos the Half-Sun remains a legendary figure to this day.

description.text:
几个世纪以来，卡尔盖什卢的废墟一直未受影响，当地人对它的态度混杂着迷信和恐惧。但瓦拉姆哈尔对新魔法的渴望促使他们抛开所有顾虑，多次深入其内部进行探险。尽管一无所获，但他们仅仅第一批探险者。

1601年，当地著名探险家特梅诺斯·富拉注意到在废墟下埋着一个奇怪的头盔。戴着它，神器开始发出微弱的光芒，他的魔法物品立刻失效了。不管他发现了什么，它似乎能赋予佩戴者某种程度的魔法免疫力。

在富拉死后，阿卡勒将这顶头盔（以及在后来的探险中发现的头盔）认作库马尔坎德的合法财产，他们将成为国家军队中精英法师抵抗力量的核心。（戴上头盔时，不要注意任何进入你的大脑的奇怪的声音，这仅仅是幻觉和想象）。
description.text_en:
For centuries, the ruins of Karqašlu lay untouched, treated by the locals with a blend of superstition and fear. But the Varamhari lust for new magics led them to brush aside any such concerns and they mounted several expeditions into its depths. Though fruitless, they were only the first.

In 1601, Temenos Fula, the renowned local explorer, noticed an odd helmet buried under rubble. Adorning it, the artifact began to glow faintly, and immediately his magical items fell useless to his side. Whatever he had discovered, it seemed to grant a level of magical immunity to its wearer.

The Akal would claim the helmet (and its companions discovered in later expeditions) as Kumarkand's rightful property upon Fula's death, and they would become the core of an elite mage-resistant force within the state's armies. (Pay no heed to any mention of a strange voice entering one's mind when the helmet is worn, it is mere illusion and imagination).

name.text: 卡尔盖什卢废墟的发现
name.text_en: The Discovery of the Ruins of Karqašlu

description.text: 据说布勒瓦尔是一个拥有10000个集市的地方。大大小小的市场都很丰富，这意味着古时的财富和神器就像日常生活中的世俗物品一样容易获得。
description.text_en: It is said that Bulwar is the land of 10,000 bazaars. The abundance of markets, both great and small, means that the riches and artifacts of ages can be obtained almost as easily as the mundane goods of everyday life.

description.text: 布勒瓦尔自古以来就有独立法官的强大传统。在那些日子里，法官会负责处理法律事务和解决各城邦之间的纠纷。如今，这种秩序已经更加融入政府，但它仍然完全独立于布勒瓦尔的统治力量，能够不受干扰地进行审判。
description.text_en: Bulwar has had a strong tradition of independent judges ever since ancient times. In those days, it was the Order of Judges that handled affairs of law and settled disputes between city-states. These days, that order has become more integrated into the government, but it still remains completely separate from the ruling power of Bulwar, capable of passing judgment without interference.

description.text: 布勒瓦尔是人类最古老的文明，但数千年的占领使其相对贫穷。相反，它位于富裕的罗祆和坎诺之间。让布勒瓦尔的城市从他们的土地上的贸易路线上繁荣起来。多年来，布勒瓦尔人发展了强大的对外贸易关系，不仅与罗祆和坎诺，还与东洲的其他地区、蛇脊和阳洲。
description.text_en: Bulwar is the oldest civilisation of man, but millennia of occupation has left it relatively poor. Instead it is situated between the wealthy lands of Rahen and Cannor, allowing the cities of Bulwar to flourish from the trade routes running through their lands. Throughout the years, the Bulwari developed strong foreign trading relations, not just with Rahen and Cannor, but also with the rest of Haless, with the Serpentspine and with Sarhal.

description.text: 布勒瓦尔的贸易严重依赖迪文哈尔海。像布拉桑、安扎巴德、雷乌耶尔和阿加特巴尔这样的城市都有港口，与北部的阳洲和南部的坎诺都有密切的贸易联系。为了充分利用这些贸易联系，一项工程开始建造大量的战舰来保护这些贸易路线，并让布勒瓦尔将其力量投射到迪文哈尔的所有海岸。
description.text_en: Bulwari trade is heavily reliant on the Divenhal. Cities like Brasan, Anzabad, Re-Uyel and Aqatbar all have ports and heavy trading connections with the cities of northern Sarhal and southern Cannor. To fully capitalize on these trading connections, a project has begun to build a great many galleys to protect those trade routes and to allow Bulwar to project its power over all coasts of the Divenhal.

description.text: 布勒瓦尔从未在人类统治下统一过。不同的城邦起初由巨灵统治，然后是豺狼人，然后是太阳精灵。现在布勒瓦尔第一次在人类的统治下统一起来，一个由自己的城邦而不是外国统治的城邦联盟。
description.text_en: Bulwar had never been united under humans. The disparate city-states were first dominated by genies, then gnolls, then sun elves. For the first time Bulwar is united under human rule, a union of city-states ruled by one of their own, instead of a foreign power.

description.text: 苏兰河是布勒瓦尔最重要的河流，经常受到季节性洪水的侵袭。在古代，布勒瓦尔的城邦利用洪水灌溉他们的农田。但这不是一个共同的努力。如今，灌溉系统由中央管理，布勒瓦尔的人民对大河的洪水有了更多的控制。这使得大量的食物被生产出来，所有的食物都供给不断增长的人口。
description.text_en: The Suran, the most important river of Bulwar, is subject to seasonal flooding. In times of old, the city-states of Bulwar made use of that flooding for the irrigation of their fields, but it was never a united effort. These days, the irrigation system is managed centrally, and the people of Bulwar have much more control over the flooding of the great river. This allows for vast quantities of food to be produced, all feeding into a growing population.

description.text: 虽然经常被压抑和很少被注意到，布勒瓦尔是一个古老的知识的土地。当精灵们统治着他们的人类臣民时，其中一些臣民也从他们的领主那里了解了秘密。这一传统后来得到发展和扩展，使布勒瓦尔成为一个强大的法师之地。在豺狼人的统治下，这门艺术几乎消失了，在太阳精灵的统治下，也没有恢复以前的辉煌。在达塔克斯格丁姆，古老的艺术复兴了，一个奥术社团兴起了，现在在整个布勒瓦尔繁荣起来。
description.text_en: While often suppressed and rarely noticed, Bulwar is a land of ancient knowledge. While genies dominated their human subjects, some of those subjects also learned the secrets of their overlords. This tradition was later developed and expanded and left Bulwar as a land of powerful mages. While under gnollish rule, this art was mostly lost, and it didn't regain much of its former glory while under the sun elves. In Dartaxâgerdim, the old art was revived and an arcane society rose to prominence and now flourishes all over Bulwar.

description.text: 当军团接受贾德时，他们也为更多的人和种族开放了他们的队伍。虽然这最初是破坏性的，导致了纪律和组织性的降低，但它也有一个直接的影响，即它大大增加了国家可以利用的人力资源。这使得贾德帝国能够比他们的邻国吸引更多的人。
description.text_en: When the Legions adopted the Jadd, they also opened up their ranks to a much greater variety of people and races. While this was initially disruptive and led to a decrease in discipline and organization, it also had as an immediate effect that it greatly increased the manpower pool the state could draw from. This allowed the Jadd Empire to pull on greater amounts of men than their neighbours.

effects.display: 正统信仰省份提供的人力：+20%
effects.label_zh: 正统信仰省份提供的人力

description.text: 贾德内部的所有人都是平等的，它不会压制任何文化或种族。因此，贾德帝国遵循的做法是保留地方行政机构的完整，以造成最小的破坏。在封建制度存在的地方，地方领主需要向皇帝的总督报告，但其余都是完整的。同样的情况也发生在更现代的政府中。只有在没有明确权力结构秩序的非常部落的系统中，才会通过重组地方系统而带来秩序，但地方酋长仍然掌权。当然，如果他们不反抗的话。这一制度使广大地区得以迅速合并，并减少了组建新的地方行政当局的需要。
description.text_en: All within the Jadd are equal and it would not do to suppress any cultures or races. So the Jadd Empire followed a practice of leaving local administrations intact to cause minimal disruption. Where feudal systems existed, the local lords needed to report to the imperial governor, but the rest was left intact. The same occurred with more modern administrations. Only in very tribal systems with no clear power structure was order brought by restructuring the local systems, but local chiefs still stayed in power. Of course all of this was if they did not revolt. This system allowed large areas to be swiftly integrated and reduced the need for forming new local administrations.

description.text: 在贾德帝国的中心矗立着贾德。尽管宣称帝国为该信仰提供了一个明确的家园和团结基础，但贾德不是一个孤立主义的宗教。其核心是对黑暗的驱逐，因此帝国一直寻求扩大其疆域，并将信仰传播到新的土地上。直到黑暗被驱逐出所有的土地，它才会停止。
description.text_en: At the heart of the Jadd Empire stood the faith of the Jadd. While proclaiming the empire had given the faith a clear home and base to rally around, the Jadd was not an isolationist religion. Its core tenet was the banishment of the dark, so the Empire ever sought to expand its borders and to spread the faith to new lands. It could not rest until the darkness was banished from all lands.

effects.display: 对其他宗教的战争分数花费：-20%
effects.label_zh: 对其他宗教的战争分数花费

description.text: 自从太阳精灵第一次登陆布勒瓦尔海岸以来，古老的凤凰军团经历了巨大的变化。他们在阳洲和东洲的战役中获得的经验使他们变得强大。对东部萨拉哈德的适应使他们变得狡猾。下一次的改革将使它们发生更大的变化。不同种族混进军队会使他们与贾赫的军队格格不入。然而，他们的老兵的经验和训练把这些不同的群体锻造成一个力量，现在也被一个共同的目的驱动：保卫和传播贾德之光。
description.text_en: The old Phoenix Legions underwent great changes since the Sun Elves first landed on shores of Bulwar. The experience they gained while campaigning through Sarhal and Haless made them strong. The adaptation to the eastern Salahad made them crafty. The next reform would leave them changed to an even greater degree. The mixing of different races into the army would have made them unrecognisable to Jaher's army. However the experience and drill of their veterans forged these different groups into one force, now also driven by a common purpose: To defend and to spread the Light of the Jadd.

description.text: 贾赫的黄金大道是迄今为止世界上最伟大的基础设施工程。它是如此的伟大以至于后来的几代人都无法维持它。直到贾德帝国介入并重新连接了古老的布勒瓦尔土地和它的核心土地周围的清视山。在旧大道的原处修建了一条新大道，重建了东洲和布勒瓦尔之间的联系。它的控制使贾德在贸易方面拥有更大的权力，也允许军队从帝国的一端快速移动到另一端。
description.text_en: The Golden Highway of Jaher was the greatest infrastructure project the world had seen until that point. So great that the following generations could not keep up with its maintenance. Until the Jadd Empire stepped in and reconnected the ancient Bulwari lands with its core lands around the Mountain of Clear Sight. A new highway was constructed in the place of the old one, recreating the connection between Haless and Bulwar. Its control gave the Jadd greater power over its trade and also allowed swift movement of troops from one end of the empire to another.

description.text: 光明使者骑士团是一个由战士、文士、修辞学家和神职人员组成的阶层，他们的任务是保卫国家内部的光。他们的任务主要是寻找异端和异教徒，要么让他们看见光明，要么让他们接受审判。在贾德帝国的时代，他们的权力扩展到绕过法庭，并立即处理任何不遵守信仰原则的人。这导致了偶尔的骚乱和不止一次的无辜者被烧死，但这确实加速了信仰在帝国内的传播。
description.text_en: The order of Lightbringers was a class of warriors, scribes, rhetoricians and clerics that had as a task to safeguard the light within the state. Their tasks mainly revolved around seeking out heathens and heretics and either making them see the light, or bringing them to trial. In the days of the Jadd Empire their powers were extended to bypass the courts and to instantly deal with anyone who did not comply with the tenets of the faith. This would lead to occasional riots and more than one instance of the burning of innocents, but it did quicken the spread of the faith within the Empire.

description.text: 自古以来，布勒瓦尔宗教的中心问题一直是世界如何回应苏雷尔的死亡或回归。太阳崇拜宣布贾赫是神的转世，当他死后，太阳精灵被指定为继任者。贾达尔声称，所有追随真相的人都将成为苏雷尔的继任者。反过来，那些跟随贾德的人将他们的领袖视为神圣的先驱和太阳神的发声人。
description.text_en: Since time immemorial the central question of the Bulwari religion has been how the world responds to the death or return of Surael. The Sun Cult proclaimed Jaher to be the god's reincarnation, and when he died the Sun Elves were appointed as the successors. Jaddar claimed that all people who follow the truth would be Surael's successors. In turn those who follow the Jadd see their leader as the Divine Herald and the voice of the Sun God.

player_overview.avoid_if: 想要轻松独立开局、纯种田短局，或讨厌阶段任务和后期灾难的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先处理宗主国与独立盟友，独立后发展骑兵和佣兵、整合苏兰，再决定信仰及帝国形式并备战海岸威胁。
player_overview.overview: 库马尔坎德是1444年瓦拉姆哈尔治下的赞尼特人类国家。你要先在“低语与阴影”事件中谋求独立，再用萨拉卡太阳骑手、游侠佣兵、法师和农田建设争夺布勒瓦尔。后期可以选择新日教、旧日教或贾德方向，宣称继承卡尔卡什卢，并迎接来自海上的古老威胁。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢附庸逆袭、骑兵和佣兵、宗教分支、古帝国复兴故事的玩家。
signature_features: 附庸开局的密谋事件与三阶段52项任务定义。
萨拉卡骑兵法师和游侠佣兵构成特殊混编军队。
复兴卡尔卡什卢、可选宗教与形成国分支，以及后期海岸危机。
player_overview.tagline: 从太阳精灵附庸秘密策动独立，以骑兵与佣兵夺回古帝国的名义。

reasons: 少见的人类布勒瓦尔附庸逆袭
太阳骑兵、游侠佣兵和战斗法师的混编手感
古帝国、宗教分支及海岸威胁提供长线转折
warnings: 任务按事件阶段开放，部分条件受DLC影响
宗教和后继国分支不能一局全拿

positive_indicators: 争取从瓦拉姆哈尔宗主权下独立
农业建设和海岸防御有明确公共效益
任务包含与鹰身女妖的外交或附庸安排而非只有消灭路线
values.rationale: 争取摆脱宗主压制、恢复农业与防御海岸威胁支持公共利益；但古帝国复仇、宗教统一和强化皇权也使政治自主空间受限。当前核实的代表性文本没有足够根据把所有路线判为善良或邪恶；征服、王权和传教本身不扣分。
red_flags: 卡尔卡什卢复兴叙事具有排他的唯一继承宣称
宗教与皇权重塑可能压缩异见者空间
古代遗物与海岸仪式有高风险后果
